hero.headline: SUVs, trucks, and the car you trade
hero.sub: Highline Motors sits at 469 Conchester Hwy in Aston with used SUVs, sedans, trucks, and vans on the row. Recent inventory has run Honda CR-Vs, Ford Fusions, Subaru Foresters, BMW X3s, Lexus RXs, and Audi Q5s. Bring the car you already drive. Pat is the name regulars keep using when the deal actually closes.

offerings.heading: What the Conchester Highway lot actually holds

items.title: SUVs, trucks, sedans, vans
items.text: The lot turns over Honda, Ford, Subaru, BMW, Lexus, Audi, Chevy, and GMC. You walk a CR-V, a Forester, an Explorer, a Silverado, or a Sienna depending on the week. The car you buy is the one sitting in Aston that day.

items.title: Trade-ins with Pat
items.text: They want your vehicle. Trade-ins are half the driveway. Pat works the deal so the car you drive in can pay down the car you drive out. Miss Jay is the other name people mention when the paperwork stays calm.

items.title: A weekday lot you can actually catch
items.text: Monday through Friday the lot runs 9am to 6pm. Saturday is 10am to 4pm. You look at miles, you take a drive, you talk money on Conchester Highway before anyone emails a maybe.

story.heading: Aston, on the highway, with a person on the lot
paragraphs: Highline Motors is the used-car stop on Conchester Highway when you want an SUV or a truck you can see in daylight. Buyers come back for a second car years later and still ask for Pat. The inventory moves: Honda and Subaru for the school run, Ford and Chevy when you need the bed, BMW and Lexus when the budget can take the badge.

A deal here is walk the row, pick the vehicle, put your trade on the table. People who liked the lot talk about leaving with a car that lasted. Look at the specific car. Ask Pat the hard questions while you are still on the pavement.

experience.heading: How an Aston deal actually starts

items.title: Walk the SUVs and trucks
items.text: CR-Vs, Foresters, Explorers, Silverados, and the sedan row sit in the same lot. You pick the one with the miles you can live with.

items.title: Put your trade in the conversation
items.text: Drive in with the car you have. Pat and Miss Jay work the number so the trade is part of the deal, not a later errand.

items.title: Leave Conchester in the new one
items.text: Weekdays until 6, Saturday until 4. The purchase happens around a vehicle that is already in Aston.

feature.heading: Honda to Lexus, plus the trade
feature.text: Highline Motors turns over SUVs, trucks, sedans, and vans on Conchester Highway. Honda, Ford, Subaru, BMW, Lexus, Audi show up on the row. Pat works the trade so you are not stuck with two cars in the driveway.

spotlight.heading: Ask for Pat
spotlight.text: Regulars who bought twice still name Pat. Miss Jay shows up in the paperwork stories. Highline Motors is that Aston lot: look at the SUV, talk the trade, decide before dark.

items.title: SUVs and crossovers
items.text: Honda CR-V, Subaru Forester, BMW X3, Lexus RX, Audi Q5, and the week's other crossovers.

items.title: Trucks and vans
items.text: Silverados, Explorers, Siennas, and the work vehicles that share the Aston row.

items.title: Trade-ins
items.text: Bring the car you have. Pat works the number into the car you want.
